map.为文本每行添加连续行号，支持自定义起始值与分隔符，便于代码粘贴、文稿引用与步骤清: Adds sequential line numbers to every line of text, with a customizable start value and separator, making code pasting, document citation, and step-list annotation easier. Copy the numbered result with one click.
map.代码展示与引用：给片段加 1. 2. 行号，便于讨论时定位「第 N 行」。: Code display and citation: number snippets as 1., 2. so discussions can point at "line N".
map.教学与文档：标注步骤序号，读者可对照。: Teaching and documentation: label step numbers so readers can follow along.
map.日志对齐：给截取日志加行号便于回溯。: Log alignment: number an excerpted log to make back-tracking easier.
map.：粘贴 5 行，设起始 1、格式「N. 」，输出「1. …/2. …」；导出后引: : paste 5 lines, set the start to 1 and the format to "N. ", and you get "1. …/2. …"; after export, a reference like "see line 3" is immediately clear.
map.能从指定数开始吗？: Can It Start from a Given Number?
map.可以设起始值（如从 10 开始），适合接在上一段之后连续编号。: Yes, you can set the start value (for example from 10), which is handy for continuous numbering after a previous block.
map.支持「N.」「N)」「[N]」等；纯展示用，不影响原文本逻辑。: Supports "N.", "N)", "[N]" and more; purely for display and does not affect the original text logic.
map.→ 打开添加行号工具: → Open the Add Line Numbers tool
